newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenya sells 6.56 billion shillings in T-bills.
newsitem.headline: Kenya sells 6.56 billion shillings in T-bills.

text.p: The Central Bank of Kenya sold 6.556 billion shillings($119.4 million) of treasury bills at its weekly auction on Thursday, bank officials said.
The bank said it sold 6.395 billion shillings of the 91-day main category of bills at an average yield of 21.450 percent compared to 6.778 billion shillings at 21.465 last week.
In the 28-day category, the bank sold 161 million shillings at 16.754 percent from 24 million shillings, yield unchanged.
The bank invited tenders for seven billion shillings of treasury bills for the next auction on Thursday.
